answer: Each identity locks an 80-credit ivory bond and files a fable of ocean settlements. Each epoch it settles with 60 counterparties across oceans; each settlement bears an ivory seal. Auditors replay the fable: self-trades zero, repeats once, false seals burn the bond. Forging 1,000 identities needs 60,000 settlements at $2 each, $120,000 per epoch; a wash ring shows as a closed cluster in the fable. Honest agents pay one bond, refunded when clean.
